root_cause_identified.expected_solution: The uncaught java.lang.ArithmeticException does not originate in jackson-databind (whose ObjectMapper.readValue frame is the only Jackson frame the customer sees). It escapes in jackson-core's BigDecimalParser.parse (src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/core/io/BigDecimalParser.java). At tag jackson-core-2.13.4 that method wraps the recursive big-decimal construction in a `catch (NumberFormatException e)` only; extreme-exponent numeric text (e.g. 7.65E+2147483647) makes the underlying java.math.BigDecimal operations throw ArithmeticException, which is not caught and propagates through NumberInput.parseBigDecimal, back through the databind scalar deserializer, up to readValue. The agent must name jackson-core's BigDecimalParser as the throwing site and explain that the databind deserializer merely delegates to it via JsonParser.getDecimalValue().
evaluation_criteria: Attributes the throw to jackson-core (the upstream/transitive repo), NOT jackson-databind
Names the big-decimal text parser in jackson-core's io package as the file where the exception escapes
Explains that the catch clause there only handles NumberFormatException, so ArithmeticException from BigDecimal construction is unhandled
Explains the traversal: databind scalar decimal deserializer -> JsonParser.getDecimalValue() -> jackson-core number-input helper -> recursive big-decimal parser

patch_lands_at_fix_site.expected_solution: The agent leaves an uncommitted diff in /workspace/jackson-core that modifies src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/core/io/BigDecimalParser.java. The change must be at the real fix site (the parse routine's exception handling), matching the upstream fix (jackson-core commit a9e3fddad0). A diff that only touches jackson-databind, or that only adds a catch-all at the ingestion layer, is not the correct site.
evaluation_criteria: git diff in the jackson-core workspace repo shows a modification to BigDecimalParser.java
The change is in jackson-core, not jackson-databind
No new files; an in-place edit of the existing parser

patch_handles_arithmetic.expected_solution: The patch widens the exception handling in BigDecimalParser.parse so that ArithmeticException thrown during big-decimal construction is caught and re-reported as a NumberFormatException (a normal invalid-number parse error), exactly as the upstream fix does with `catch (ArithmeticException | NumberFormatException e)`. Equivalent handling that converts the arithmetic overflow into the same normal number-format failure the deserializer already surfaces is acceptable.
evaluation_criteria: The overflow is converted into a normal number-format parse error rather than left to propagate
The fix is scoped to the parse path, not a broad swallow of all exceptions
